title: bug: CBOR array-skip accumulator overflow bypasses bounds check
description: RECLASSIFIED from P0 bug: the accumulator overflow does not occur in current code. Each successful cbor_skip call returns n where cur+n<=buflen (the recursive call can only succeed if data fits in [cur,buflen)), so cur is bounded by buflen<=MAX_CT_LEN=524288 throughout. The 'if (cur < pos)' check is dead code (cur is monotonically increasing) and misleadingly implies overflow risk. This is now tracked as a dead-code cleanup in wolfP11-g750. This bead is superseded by wolfP11-g750; keeping for audit trail.
